# BB00601: Letter to the wife of the Bab, in Chihriq {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Glorious, Most Beautiful, Most Great, Most Luminous

My dear soul, in all conditions keep your heart at peace through praise of the Truth, and continue to beseech divine grace for the day of reunion, for whatever good there is, the Lord of the world has ordained and will cause to flow.

And my sorrow is for the dwellers of the house, that no grief should befall them, for otherwise there is no solace except contentment with the divine decree. Convey greetings to the mother and to all. And blessings be upon Muhammad and his family at all times.
